hero.title: French Digital Health Agency: measuring the CO₂ impact of health applications
hero.subtitle: The ANS set up a portal to measure and project CO₂ impact for web and mobile health applications, required for listing on Mon Espace Santé.

logos.alt: Logo of the French Republic, Ministry of Solidarity and Health

intro.title: A dedicated portal to assess the impact of health applications
paragraphs: The French Digital Health Agency wanted a dedicated portal to measure and project the CO₂ impact of web and mobile health applications.
This assessment is mandatory to be listed on Mon Espace Santé. The scheme covers two categories of applications:
The project had to allow publishers to perform their own assessment, with no prior training, while ensuring measurement reliability.

image.alt: Screenshot of the Ecoscore Portal used to assess health applications

results.title: 70+ publishers assessed on the Ecoscore Portal
items: Public evaluation and ranking of publishers by the French Digital Health Agency on the Ecoscore Portal.
Assessment performed by publishers themselves, with no prior training, thanks to Greenspector Studio's intuitive interface.

items.title: Self-service onboarding
items.text: The interface was reworked with a dedicated tutorial so publishers can complete their assessment independently.

items.title: Measurements on real devices
items.text: Measurements on real devices convinced the ANS of the reliability of the Greenspector approach.

items.title: A dedicated white-label portal
items.text: A dedicated white-label portal was deployed to display results and make them easy to consult.

items.title: Tests adapted to teleconsultation
items.text: Teleconsultation tests run on two devices simultaneously to reflect real usage conditions.

testimonial.title: Dr Brigitte Séroussi speaks
quotes: « To ensure maximum ecoscore reliability, teams relied on Greenspector, which reliably assesses the environmental impact of a health application. »
« Greenspector is based on measurement throughout the real application usage journey, rather than simply calculating the environmental impact of loading the home page. »
